delete.description: Disable Phone Number Reputation. All registered numbers are de-registered as a cascade. The enterprise itself is unaffected. Returns `204` on success, `404` if reputation is not enabled for this enterprise.
delete.summary: Disable phone-number reputation for an enterprise

get.description:
Phone Number Reputation tracks how your outbound caller-IDs are perceived (spam risk, engagement, etc.) across the call-screening ecosystem. This endpoint reads the enterprise-level settings: whether the product is enabled, the refresh cadence, and the stored Letter of Authorization document id.

Returns `404` if reputation has never been enabled for this enterprise.
get.summary: Get phone-number reputation settings for an enterprise

post.description:
Activate Phone Number Reputation for the given enterprise. Requires an uploaded Letter of Authorization document (the `loa_document_id` references the Telnyx Documents API) and a refresh-frequency selection. After activation, individual phone numbers can be registered via `POST .../reputation/numbers`.

**Prerequisite**: the calling user must have agreed to the Phone Number Reputation Terms of Service (`POST /terms_of_service/number_reputation/agree`).

Failure modes:
- `403` - Phone Number Reputation Terms of Service not accepted.
- `404` - enterprise does not exist or does not belong to your account.
- `400` - reputation already enabled for this enterprise.
- `422` - `loa_document_id` missing or `check_frequency` invalid.

**Pricing:** This is a billable action. See https://telnyx.com/pricing/numbers for current pricing.
post.summary: Enable phone-number reputation for an enterprise

get.description: Get the review status of the enterprise's ownership proof for phone numbers hosted with another provider. Returns 404 when no proof has been submitted.

post.description: Request permission to add phone numbers that the enterprise owns but that are hosted with another provider. Submit one or more uploaded documents proving ownership, such as a carrier invoice or account statement. The request is reviewed once per enterprise. While it is `pending` or `rejected` you can submit again to replace the documents; once `approved` it cannot be changed.

201.description: The ownership proof was submitted for review.

post.summary: Submit ownership proof for numbers hosted elsewhere

patch.description:
Update how often Telnyx refreshes the reputation data for this enterprise's registered numbers. The new frequency takes effect on the next scheduled refresh.

The enterprise's reputation must be in `approved` status. A request made while the status is `pending` is rejected with `400 Bad Request`.
Point the enterprise's reputation settings at a new signed LOA document. This resets LOA approval to `pending`; the new document must be approved before additional phone numbers can be added.
patch.summary: Replace the reputation Letter of Authorization document

post.description: Render the LOA for this enterprise as a PDF. The enterprise identity, address, and authorized-representative contact are taken from the enterprise record; the optional `agent` block is supplied only when a third-party partner manages the numbers. The response is the PDF itself (unsigned unless a `signature` is provided). Sign it and upload it to the Telnyx Documents API (`POST /v2/documents`, see https://developers.telnyx.com/api/documents) to obtain the `loa_document_id` required by `POST .../reputation`.
post.summary: Render a phone-number reputation Letter of Authorization

post.description:
Add up to 100 phone numbers to reputation monitoring on this enterprise. Each must be in E.164 format (`+1NPANXXXXXX` for US/CA). A number in your Telnyx phone-number inventory is accepted as `source: telnyx`; a number that is not is treated as hosted with another provider and must meet the requirements below.

**Prerequisite**: reputation must already be enabled on this enterprise (see `POST .../reputation`).

**Pricing:** This is a billable action. See https://telnyx.com/pricing/numbers for current pricing.

A phone number that is not in your Telnyx inventory is treated as a number hosted with another provider (`source: external`). It must be a US local number, and the enterprise's ownership proof must be approved first (`POST /enterprises/{enterprise_id}/reputation/external_verification`); otherwise the request fails with a 400 whose `detail` contains `external_verification_required`. Ownership of such numbers is checked every day.
post.summary: Register phone numbers for reputation monitoring

post.description:
Immediately refresh the stored reputation data for the listed numbers. This is in addition to the periodic refresh determined by `check_frequency`. Up to 100 numbers per call. The response carries the kicked-off jobs; the actual refresh runs asynchronously.

**Pricing:** Forcing a refresh performs live reputation lookups, which are billable. See https://telnyx.com/pricing/numbers for current pricing.

200.description: Refresh completed (the call is synchronous from the customer's POV - Telnyx fans out to the reputation feed before responding).

post.description:
Answer an ownership question about a phone number hosted with another provider.

Send `still_own: true` to confirm you still own a number whose `ownership_status` is `pending_confirmation` or `flagged`; its status returns to `verified` and, after a carrier change, the new carrier becomes the one on record.

Send `still_own: false` to report that you no longer own the number. It is removed from Number Reputation immediately, whatever its current status, and the response shows it with `ownership_status: removed`.

200.description: The phone number after the confirmation, or the removed number.

post.summary: Confirm or give up ownership of a phone number
